DIAGNOSIS READY: Hypoxic-Ischemic Encephalopathy (HIE).

The clinical picture of a 31-week premature infant with a history of chorioamnionitis, low birth weight, and the development of seizures and lethargy three days post-delivery, combined with normal initial septic workup and imaging showing likely white matter injury, strongly points to perinatal asphyxia leading to HIE.
